title: pellaea tenera
intro: Pellaea tenera, commonly known as the Soft Rattlesnake Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea tenera include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pellaea tenera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
